svg.text: MCP6002 ground from MCP4728 • MCP6002 supply from ADS1115 VIN • insulated underside jumpers
1. COMPONENT SIDE — install sockets and parts
QT sockets at left / right edges
QT sockets at left / right edges
External QT cable → LEFT edge. Sensor clamp pair → RIGHT edge.
Module-to-module QT cable stays above the boards; plug clearance must be checked.
Solder only the two listed endpoints of each jumper.
Crossings are insulated overpasses. Passing a hole does NOT connect it.
Columns run 24 → 1 here; rows stay A → R. Red A1 marks the same physical hole.
JUMPER LIST — coordinates identify the same physical holes in both views
Use this as a new-build plan, not a tracing of your existing solder joints. Socket endpoints for R1 are assumed to be positions 1 and 8.
Dry-fit modules, resistor and QT plugs first. C1 = 100 nF follows V1; keep your verified value if it differs. QT power must be 3.3 V.
Before inserting modules: inspect for bridges and verify jumper continuity / no supply-to-ground short. This image is not a 1:1 drilling template.
